title: Cryptex Storage Cylinder (Locking Jar)
what: A purely mechanical combination locking cylinder with interlocking notched tumblers.
why: Engineered as an advanced mechanism challenge to demonstrate precision mechanical design, rotating cam tracks, and tight 3D printing tolerances.
how: Designed in SolidWorks with multi-ring internal locking grooves and alignment pins, 3D printed with tuned dimensional tolerances for smooth rotational feel without binding.
